renderings.value: A molester is truly the enemy of women. I'll never let them get away with it.
I can't stand dirty old men in the subway.
There have been many attacks by molesters lately. Please try to walk on bright and well-frequented roads as much as possible.
Even if you see boobs in front of you on the train, don't touch them. You'll get called a molester and arrested.
That is the park infested with perverts.
